findings.evidence: "The portal walks through each step in order."
findings.violation: It is unclear what steps the portal walks through or what "in order" means in this context.
findings.fix: Replace with: "The portal guides you through the request process step by step."

findings.evidence: "The requester gets an automatic reminder after three days."
findings.violation: The reminder's purpose is not stated - it is unclear whether this is a reminder to complete an incomplete request or for some other purpose.
findings.fix: Replace with: "The requester gets an automatic reminder to complete the request after three days."

findings.evidence: "A photo of the receipt is enough for most requests."
findings.violation: The phrase "most requests" is vague and leaves uncertainty about which requests require something different.
findings.fix: Replace with: "For most items, a photo of the receipt is sufficient proof of purchase."

findings.evidence: "You must keep your equipment in good working condition and we may ask for a brief photo check once a year."
findings.violation: The sentence switches between "You" and "we" pronouns, creating inconsistent voice.
findings.fix: Use consistent pronouns: "You must keep your equipment in good working condition. We may ask for a photo verification once a year."

findings.evidence: "we may ask for a brief photo check once a year"
findings.violation: "Brief photo check" is vague - it is unclear what will be photographed, how the photo should be submitted, or what condition issues might disqualify equipment.
findings.fix: Replace with: "We may request photos of your equipment to verify it remains in acceptable working condition once annually."

findings.evidence: "Similarly, the policy applies to one device per category per employee."
findings.violation: The transition word "Similarly" does not connect logically to the previous sentence about equipment maintenance.
findings.fix: Replace with: "Additionally, the policy limits purchases to one device per category per employee."

findings.evidence: Section heading is "Terminology Notes" but the content describes operational processes
findings.violation: The section title is misleading - the section contains process descriptions, not terminology definitions.
findings.fix: Rename the section to "Process Overview" or "Stipend Processing Steps."

findings.evidence: "The team logs each request the moment it arrives. The team then routes the request... Once approved, the team schedules..."
findings.violation: "The team" is repeated excessively in quick succession, making the passage feel repetitive.
findings.fix: Restructure to vary the subject: "The benefits team logs each request upon arrival. Once received, requests are routed to the appropriate approver by department. After approval, reimbursement is scheduled for the next pay cycle."

findings.evidence: "Completing the request begins with confirming eligibility, and uploading the receipt."
findings.violation: The sentence structure lacks parallel form - "confirming" and "uploading" should follow the same grammatical pattern.
findings.fix: Replace with: "To complete the request, you must confirm your eligibility and upload your receipt."

findings.evidence: "The benefits team reviews the equipment catalog at the start of the fiscal year."
findings.violation: This repeats information already stated in the "Special Cases" section (line 59) about when the equipment catalog is published.
findings.fix: Remove this sentence from "Questions and Updates" or consolidate the information into one section.
